topic: How Maya Civilisation Poisoned Its Own Water with Mercury
pillar: Historical facts that challenge common assumptions
hook: The ancient Maya used so much bright red cinnabar paint that they accidentally poisoned their own water supply.
youtube_query: maya mercury water poisoning red paint

evidence.title: The Maya used so much red paint that they poisoned their water with mercury, mud sediments reveal
Ancient Maya unknowingly poisoned Yucatán water with mercury - Live Science
Ancient Maya Red Paint Polluted Lakes With Mercury for Centuries - Around Prague

angle: Examine how the very sacred rituals meant to appease Maya rain gods ironically deposited toxic mercury into the reservoirs that sustained their largest cities.
what_others_do: Existing discussions typically focus broadly on archaeological discoveries of heavy metals in ruins without exploring the specific religious practices that caused the contamination.
